stem.text: Two coins are projected from a horizontal table at the same initial speed $u$.
Coin Y is projected upwards at an angle of $30^{\circ}$ to the horizontal.

stem.alt: Diagram of a grey table edge with two coins at its right edge. Coin Y is projected upwards at 30 degrees to the horizontal, and coin X is projected horizontally. Each coin has an arrow labelled u.

stem.text: Both coins hit the horizontal ground without bouncing.
Assume the air resistance on each coin is negligible.
Which statement about the motion of the coins is correct?

A.text: Both coins hit the ground with the same speed.

B.text: Both coins travel the same vertical distance.

C.text: Coin Y hits the ground before coin X.

D.text: Coin Y has a smaller vertical acceleration.
